slices.title: Implement pixel-perfect UI updates matching approved mockup design
slices.jtbd: When implementing approved design styling for this epic, I want to synchronize component markup and CSS in frontend/src/App.svelte and src/main/resources/static/index.html with design/approved/20261117205521-mockup/mockup.html, so that the knowledge base presentation matches the approved visual specification pixel-for-pixel.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261117205521-mockup/mockup.html
When a developer updates the frontend markup, color tokens, and layout styles in frontend/src/App.svelte
Then all typography, margins, border radii, and visual container classes match the approved mockup layout
And running visual inspection or end-to-end tests verifies zero rendering regressions across mobile and desktop viewports.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression diff percentage < 0.1% against approved mockup
